maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from freight, utility and waste invoice payment processing, audit fees and bank net interest, not repairs or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are large private enterprises such as Schneider Electric and Hershey paying freight, utility and waste bills.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth has come mainly from organically extending payment and audit services into utilities, waste and telecom; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced freight and utility invoice audit and payment embedded in client payables processes; switching causes disruption and integration cost.
